scope: Seventh trial: method-only PPLs to fit the 64K RTX program image
console_report_v6: v6 compiled and passed the .fth stage; pplsim reported 'step math opcodes not supported' for both methods, v1.91 also printed 'No. Averages is not a multiple of 2' with a PPR that sets phase_cycle=1, and a rerun crashed. v18 compiled.
diagnosis: Program image overflow. The v6 .fth files use no Forth word or inline opcode absent from v18's console .fth, so the step-math popup is not a new instruction. v18's own history documents a hard 64K image ('too big to fit in 64K', 'default size 65490', arrays moved to extended memory). Estimated images: v18 56.7 KB (model), combined v6 67.7 / 65.2 KB (+11.1 / +8.6 KB). Corrupted parameter values and undecodable instructions are the expected symptoms. Not directly measured on the console.
size_model: 2.6 bytes per AST node (from the console .fth files) + declared array bytes + string bytes; v18 absolute value lacks fixed runtime overhead, differences are the decision quantity
changes: Deleted the v18 regions the method always jumped over: TE calculations, TE-extend checks and the v18 echo-train kernel (replaced by goto v19_mat_window). Preprocessor directives balanced; no deleted label referenced elsewhere.

Commented out (v18 \\#define style) features the method rejects: MULTIPRESAT, FSE3D, DRIVEN_EQUILIBRIUM, SKIP_FIRST_ECHOES, CHESS, AUTOGATE, MTC, PRESAT_FREQ_FLIP, DIXON3P. All PPR parameters remain declared.
MAX_DIFF_ACQ 512 -> 64 (the pre-v1.x size), PARAMLIST acq_* VAR_ARRAY counts and no_diff_acq range 1..64, PPR acq_* arrays truncated to their first 64 entries.
MAX_CRUSHER_ETL 1024 -> 64 (crusher_etl = ETL <= 64 in method mode; E87 still checks).

Early guards after the stop hub, before any table is read: v19_on must be 1; 1 <= no_diff_acq <= 64. The in-setup v19_on gate and v19_setup_done label are removed. v19_on PARAMLIST keeps its 0..1 range, default 1.
control_path: Removed from the v19 PPLs by design. Controls run on the unchanged v18 PPL with its own PPR. A v19 PPL with v19_on=0 is rejected before any event (previously, in an intermediate prototype, it fell into the method shot without setup).
equivalence_vs_v6: 47 protocols per method (19 valid, 28 rejected): RF timing/frames/multipliers/phases, ADC timing, played gradients, printed output and error meanings identical to the v6 combined build; differences only the intended v19_on message and the removed SKIP_FIRST_ECHOES report line. Gradient list ids shift by 8 (CHESS/MTC setup lists not compiled).

static_checks.expected_W003: pb_end (its goto is under the disabled MULTIPRESAT)

full_validator_comparison: Against the previous full run (pre-v4 hashes 2542cdd/6a70f90): bloch_results, btensor, moments, landmark_summary, timing_summary, crusher geometry scans, slice profiles and ADC echo arrays identical; convergence ODE windows shifted by -387/-420 us with identical widths (shorter untimed setup); all 38 rejection cases zero RF/ADC (codes renumbered); control_identity now records v19_on=0 rejection.
timer_arg_flags: New since the v4 int timer copies, not this trial: the mapper flags int waittimer arguments >32767 as negative (e.g. -24996) and uses their unsigned 16-bit value (40540 ticks), the same bits the earlier long arguments and v18's waittimer(47975L) deliver. Event timing identical.
error_codes: Renumbered; use docs/v19/compiler_compatibility/v19_error_codes.txt from this build (combined v6 table kept as combined_v6_error_codes.txt).
